evidence: Hashes: frozen instruction.md 58b592ff..., hireops_rules.md 0055eb3b..., integration.md 4eddd8a3..., seed_data.json a1c65c80... all equal the manifest values; environment and solution seed copies are byte-identical. Contamination grep over instruction.md and both notes for TODO|FIXME|XXX|CHANGE_ME|placeholder|TBD|lorem|<tag>|drive-letter paths|/Users/|/home/|turing-workspace|golden|judge|rubric|criteri|dimension|reward|weight|score|playwright|claude|glm|/tests|sentinel|oracle|luna|gpt|colderwater|ridgeline returned zero hits; no non-ASCII stray characters, no CRLF, no doubled words (repeated-word regex: no hits). Template CHANGE_ME stubs (template instruction.md:1, notes.md:1) are fully replaced; the template's notes.md is not shipped and integration.md lines 1-14 are template-controlled text kept verbatim, with task-authored lines 16-23 appended. Seed generated_note and all 22 distinct message/note bodies are clean product text (no author asides). Spell check: manual review of the full unique-word list of all three files (about 700 words) found no misspellings; names (Costa, Sorensen, Okafor, Halvorsen, Haddad, Varga, Fischer, Nair) match seed users/applications. Contradiction cross-check: (1) accounts in instruction.md:19 match seed users exactly (3 recruiters, 3 hiring managers, 1 observer, 3 candidates, same emails/roles); password Hireops!2026 identical in instruction.md:19 and hireops_rules.md:11; (2) one seed path /assets/seed_data.json in instruction.md:15, integration.md:7, hireops_rules.md:214; (3) DB /app/app.db + DB_PATH consistent across instruction.md:15, integration.md:7-8, hireops_rules.md:208; (4) port 3000/PORT consistent (instruction.md:15, integration.md:5, hireops_rules.md:209); (5) 15 seconds in instruction.md:5 ('fifteen') and hireops_rules.md:122; (6) page size 30 in hireops_rules.md:150-151 and seed thread_page_size=30; (7) candidate wording table hireops_rules.md:190-197 equals seed candidate_status_labels; (8) 'three jobs', 'one conversation is long', 'a few internal notes' (hireops_rules.md:214-215) match seed (3 jobs, APP-101 has 120 messages, 3 notes); (9) the activity example 'Mei Lin moved Priya Nair from Screen to Interview' (hireops_rules.md:115) uses real seed people with Priya Nair in SCREEN; (10) health: 'never touches the database' (instruction.md:15) is compatible with, and stricter than, template 'answers before database work can block startup' (integration.md:9-10); (11) /assets availability: integration.md:6-7 (template) says starting records are in /assets, instruction.md:17 says copy into /app because /assets is unavailable at runtime, and hireops_rules.md:207-208 says find starting data relative to server.js. These are compatible (where the data is supplied vs. where it is read at runtime). (12) Undo: instruction.md:3 'as long as nobody has touched those cards since' is summarized; hireops_rules.md:101-102 defines it precisely ('moved, re-ordered, rejected or reopened since, by anyone... Adding a note doesn't count'); instruction.md:11 defers exact rules to that file, so this is not a contradiction. Lessons file checks bearing on this row: no public internet address anywhere in the brief/notes (lesson 13, zero URLs); the lesson-5 'Before you hand it over...' line (instruction.md:13) is coherent with the product scope and introduces no contradiction; no leftover tightening-round drafting artifacts or duplicated paragraphs (lesson 18). Minor, non-defect observations: mixed British/American spelling ('honour'/'honouring' instruction.md:15 vs template-controlled 'honoring' integration.md:7); intentional overlap of the runtime-location rules between integration.md:21-23 and hireops_rules.md:206-210 (restated, consistent, not a pasted duplicate). Counterfactual probes: a builder following the integration.md template line and reading /assets/seed_data.json at runtime would be misled only if the instruction were silent; instruction.md:17 is explicit, so no conforming alternative is pushed wrong by contradictory text. No runtime evidence is required for this source-only row; the deterministic content/hygiene checkers were not executed here (covered by the separate deterministic reviewer).
